result.verdictNote: Dense, well-quantified experienced-hire resume with strong biodata, leadership and client exposure, and strong selectivity signals. Weaknesses are the concurrent, year-only-dated roles (Accenture, ErythroSIGHT and the postdoc overlap in 2026), some undefined jargon (rNPV, CRO, IND, CRC-P), unfamiliar partner names with no descriptor, and a two-column-style capabilities block. No hidden or injected content was found.
